// diagnostic E0771

Jet.FunctionValueLabelMismatch

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type

What

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type

Why

Public labels and parameter zones are part of a function's callable type

Fix

Match the function value's call labels and parameter zones to the expected function type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FunctionValueLabelMismatch: Tests/UI/fn_type_zone_call.stderr.

Error: Jet.LabelOnlyPassedByPosition: `force` is a label-only parameter of `action`
  --> Tests/UI/fn_type_zone_call.jet:3:69
    |
  3 | apply: fn(action: fn(*, force: Bool) -> Int) -> Int { return action(true) }
    |                                                                     ^^^^
 Why: The `*` in the declaration requires the label, so the call says what the value means
 Fix: Write `force: …` for this argument
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.LabelOnlyPassedByPosition

Error: Jet.FunctionValueLabelMismatch: This needs fn(*, force: Bool) -> Int, but the function value is fn(Bool) -> Int
  --> Tests/UI/fn_type_zone_call.jet:5:22
    |
  5 | run: fn() { _: apply(save) }
    |                      ^^^^
 Why: Public labels and parameter zones are part of a function's callable type
 Fix: Use `fn(*, force: Bool) -> Int` here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.FunctionValueLabelMismatch
